findings.current_behaviour: P0 tickets 2-3 maximise T + coverage of the Top-15 pool (coverage term SD 3.53x the T SD) and P0/forensic reports use winner capture, union coverage and total matches as success measures.
findings.why_it_matters: P(>=1 jackpot) = sum of P(ticket) over distinct tickets; coverage, union and total matches do not enter it. Under no edge every distinct 3-ticket portfolio has exactly 3/C(38,6).
findings.evidence: data/a2_objective.json: exact enumeration, P6 identical (1.0867e-6) for all distinct structures; E[total] identical (2.842) for all portfolios.
findings.proposed_correction: State the objective explicitly; tickets 2-3 chosen for zero overlap (maximises P(4+), P(3+), E[best] exactly) with evidence score only as tie-break; reclassify metrics.
findings.validation_test: exact enumeration (A2) + historical replay of the corrected constructor (strategy H)

findings.current_behaviour: Portfolio spreads available winners across tickets (#2343: 4 in-pool winners split 2/1/3).
findings.why_it_matters: Spreading is optimal for lower tiers under no edge but would cost jackpot probability if a calibrated signal existed.
findings.evidence: A3: no strategy beats its exact null (min p 0.13, Holm 1.0); concentration strategies B/D have the lowest best-ticket means (1.09/1.16 vs null 1.16/1.20). #2343: 55 pool tickets held all 4 available winners (exactly the random count C(11,2)); best rank 159/5005; the standalone top-3 each held 2.
findings.proposed_correction: Codify: concentrate only under a calibrated combination model (policy C); otherwise maximise secondary tiers.

findings.current_behaviour: P0 and every family ordering are used as if informative.
findings.why_it_matters: No ordering beats random; all downstream construction is noise-driven.
findings.evidence: A6: 100 tests, min raw p 0.077 (P0_order:top15), Holm min 1.00. Mean winner rank P0 19.42 vs 19.5.
findings.proposed_correction: Label as NO EDGE everywhere; no predictive promotion.

findings.current_behaviour: No exact-ticket probability is estimated; ticket scores are uncalibrated sums of z-scores.
findings.why_it_matters: The 6/6-aligned quantity is sum P(ticket); it cannot be optimised without a calibrated combination model.
findings.evidence: A9: conditional-Bernoulli models with causal ML beta give mean log-ratio vs uniform <= 0 for every score (P0_M 0.0000, equal -0.0103); causal beta is mostly negative.
findings.proposed_correction: Adopt the CB log-score as the primary prospective skill metric; best estimate of P(exact ticket) = 1/C(38,6).
findings.validation_test: prospective A9 metric on every future draw

findings.current_behaviour: P0 enumerates only the 5,005 combinations of the Top-15 pool.
findings.why_it_matters: With V1 holding pool numbers (#2343: 5 of 15), zero-overlap tickets are infeasible inside the pool, forcing overlap; 44%% of the full-universe top-1000 tickets lie outside the pool.
findings.evidence: A7: full universe scored in 8.8 s; full-universe top-1 always inside Top-15; share of full top-1000 inside Top-15 = 0.56.
findings.proposed_correction: Score the full 2,760,681 universe.

findings.current_behaviour: Family scores are z-scores (commensurate), but universe components are Z-normalised within the pool (scale depends on K) and the coverage term dominates T by 3.5x.
findings.why_it_matters: Relative component weights change with pool size; coverage, not evidence, drives ticket choice.
findings.proposed_correction: Normalise over the full universe; document that T is an uncalibrated ordering only.

findings.current_behaviour: V1 candidates come from one fixed 4,096-ticket sample (SEED+999) at every cutoff; H_random is one fixed ticket (05 07 14 21 33 38) in every pool.
findings.why_it_matters: Search-space limitation (0.15% of the universe; same tickets every draw) and a mislabelled control; not a predictive limitation (best sampled ticket is at the 99.98-100th percentile of each objective).
findings.proposed_correction: Research-only: per-draw source sample and per-draw H; not applied (V1 frozen).

findings.current_behaviour: No-edge fallback always takes index 3/4 of the eligible list; with the <=2-overlap rule V1 alternates between two tickets.
findings.why_it_matters: Exploration quality only; repeating a ticket does not change its per-draw jackpot probability.
findings.evidence: A11: fixed seed 114 matches vs 126 expected (p 0.91); per-draw seed 133 (p 0.25); all within chance.
findings.proposed_correction: P1 shadow (per-draw seed); V1 unchanged.

findings.current_behaviour: F_structure candidates under-represent 3+ runs; final tickets and P0 do not.
findings.why_it_matters: A structure penalty cannot change a fixed ticket's expected matches under uniform draws.
findings.proposed_correction: none

findings.current_behaviour: 183 draws 2161-2343, no gaps/duplicates/invalid values; bonus never a feature.
findings.proposed_correction: Record #2343 provenance (user-supplied official).

findings.current_behaviour: Mutation test: future rows replaced at 4 origins; features, weights, P0 order and V1 candidates identical.
findings.proposed_correction: none

findings.current_behaviour: "Confirmation" windows 2299-2343 reused by up to 7 studies.
findings.why_it_matters: Historical confirmation evidence is not a pristine holdout; any future historical pass would be optimistic.
findings.proposed_correction: Validation hierarchy: development (rolling) -> historical pseudo-holdout (descriptive only) -> prospective live draws as the only promotion evidence.

findings.current_behaviour: Holm applied within each batch only; 385 formal tests across 10 studies (plus ~3802 exploratory comparisons).
findings.why_it_matters: Batch-wise correction understates false-discovery risk.
findings.proposed_correction: Cumulative registry; promotion only on prospective evidence with a fixed alpha budget.

findings.current_behaviour: Reports headline union coverage, total matches and pool capture.
findings.why_it_matters: These do not measure 6/6; total matches is identical in expectation for every portfolio.
findings.proposed_correction: Metric classes PRIMARY/SECONDARY/DIAGNOSTIC/MISLEADING.

findings.current_behaviour: One fixed random portfolio (seed 20260930) repeated every draw.
findings.why_it_matters: A single portfolio is a very noisy null; the exact null is available analytically.
findings.proposed_correction: Keep fixed control; add per-draw seeded control and exact null pmfs.

findings.current_behaviour: Jev Choice is consulted every run; under the no-edge rule it never affects the ticket.
findings.why_it_matters: No measurable predictive value (5 saved draws).
findings.proposed_correction: Keep V1 call unchanged (protocol continuity); add order/blind tests post-freeze.

findings.current_behaviour: 14 draw-specific scripts with hard-coded draw IDs; production logic duplicated across wrappers.
findings.why_it_matters: Copy-edit errors between draws; harder to audit.
findings.proposed_correction: One parameterised entry point for the corrected protocol with hashed inputs.

findings.current_behaviour: V1 #2339-#2343: 3,0,3,0,2 (two distinct tickets). P0 best: 2, 3.
findings.why_it_matters: Consistent with chance (V1 P(total>=8)=0.073).
findings.proposed_correction: none

findings.current_behaviour: Live #2342/#2343 P0 tickets reproduce exactly from the frozen protocol; historical replay reproduces 2231-2340 exactly.
findings.proposed_correction: none

findings.why_it_matters: Intended by protocol; the historical replay re-estimates causally, so live and replay differ from #2342 on (not a bug).
